map.输入设备功率（瓦）、使用时长（小时）与电价（元/度），工具先换算为千瓦再计算应付: Enter device power (W), usage time (hours) and tariff (yuan/kWh); the tool first converts to kW then computes the electricity cost, suitable for estimating daily appliance cost.
map.输入功率 P（瓦）、用电时长 h（小时）与电价，求电费。: Enter power P (W), duration h (hours) and tariff to find electricity cost.
map.估算月度电费与阶梯影响。: Estimate monthly electricity cost and tiered-rate impact.
: Daily use 30 kWh, of which 20 kWh shifted to valley (0.3 yuan) replacing peak (0.9 yuan): original 30 x 0.58 = 17.4 yuan, optimized 10 x 0.9 + 20 x 0.3 = 15 yuan, daily saving 2.4 yuan, yearly about 876 yuan. Note: storage/smart scheduling amplifies the benefit.
map.阶梯电价怎么算？: How is tiered electricity pricing calculated?
map.按累计用量分段计价，增量部分适用更高单价，因此高用量月费用非线性上升。: Tiered pricing by cumulative usage; the incremental part uses a higher unit price, so high-usage months rise non-linearly.
map.可转移负荷（储能、热水、充电桩）用户受益大；刚性实时负荷受益有限。: Shiftable loads (storage, water heating, EV charging) benefit users most; rigid real-time loads benefit little.

Actual energy use, generation and cost depend on equipment nameplate parameters, climate, tariffs and local rules; refer to measured data, manuals and energy-authority rules, and consult an engineer for major projects.
map.阶梯电价与峰谷电费怎么算: How are tiered and time-of-use bills calculated?
map.阶梯电价按增量分段：第一档内的电量按第一档单价，超过第一档、但在第二档上限以内的: Tiered pricing applies to incremental blocks: usage within tier 1 uses the tier 1 rate, usage above tier 1 but within the tier 2 cap uses the tier 2 rate, and only usage above tier 2 uses the tier 3 rate. The whole bill is not charged at the top rate.
map.月用电 420 kWh，档位上限 240 / 400 kWh，三档单价 0.55: Monthly use 420 kWh, tier caps 240 / 400 kWh, rates 0.5583 / 0.6083 / 0.8583 CNY/kWh. Tier 1: 240 × 0.5583 ≈ 133.99; tier 2: 160 × 0.6083 ≈ 97.33; tier 3: 20 × 0.8583 ≈ 17.17; total ≈ 248.49, average ≈ 0.5916 CNY/kWh. With a 30% peak share, peak rate 0.617 and valley rate 0.307, the TOU plan is about 420 × (0.3 × 0.617 + 0.7 × 0.307) = 168.00, about 80.49 less than the tiered bill. Whether to switch also depends on whether load can actually shift.
